decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera has a dedicated page and fits the firm's space optics portfolio, and space product cycles are long, so its value is still uncertain while keeping it costs little.

The modular navigation camera has prominent web presence and shares a platform with the other camera products, so keeping the option open is cheap while demand from the growing NewSpace market resolves.
Space situational awareness is a strategically growing field with defense and institutional demand, and one year is far too early for results to justify abandoning this option.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, which suggests an earlier-stage option with weaker commitment, but its holding cost is low and its prospects remain unresolved, so it is kept for now.
